name: GetAlertsRequest
description: GetAlertsRequest schema from Varonis DatAlert API

threatModelName.description: Filter by threat model names. Supports pipe-separated values.

startTime.description: Start of the time range for alert retrieval in ISO 8601 format.

endTime.description: End of the time range for alert retrieval in ISO 8601 format.

deviceName.description: Filter by the name of the device associated with the alert.

userName.description: Filter by the user name associated with the alert.

lastDays.description: Retrieve alerts from the last N days. Alternative to using startTime and endTime.

extraFields.description: Additional fields to include in the response beyond default fields.

descendingOrder.description: When true, results are returned in descending order by time.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of alerts to return in the response.

offset.description: Number of alerts to skip for pagination.
